title: Sagalee Bosona Gubaa Irraa
intro: Eenyummaa nama gadi fagoo imalli isaa wal-qunnamtii dinqiidhaan jalqabee fi hiree isaa bilisummaa ummata cunqurfamaa wajjin wal-xaxaa ture hiikkadhu. Namni dhuunfaa kun hojii guddaadhaaf kan filatame siʼa taʼu, deggersa Waaqayyootiin qormaata guddaa isa mudate.
clues: Bara cunqursaa guddaa, daa'imman saba koo ajjeefamaa turan keessattin dhaladhe.
Jireenyi koo inni jalqabaa warra kootiin laga tokko keessa kaaʼamuu kan of keessaa qabu taʼus, mana cunqursaa saba koo keessaa argadheen guddadhe.
Yeroo tokko osoon hin yaadin yeroo waldhabdee nama dhuunfaa tokko du'aaf sababa ta'een magaalaa tokkorraa baqadheen ture.
Ergaan waaqaa fi ulee dinqii bakka qulqulluu tokkotti argadhe, achittis bulchaa humna guddaa qabuun akkan wal dura dhaabbadhu na ajajame.
Obboleessi koo ergama koo keessatti gargaaraa naaf ta’ee muudame, sababa gufuu haasaa koo keessatti natti dhaga’ame irraa kan ka’e.
Waraana abbaa irree hordofuu jalaa miliqee, galaana gargar ba’e qaxxaamuree saba koo geggeesseen ture.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Fara’oonii fi falfaltoota isaa wajjin wal dura dhaabbachuu
trial.answer: Fara’oonii fi falfaltoota isaa wajjin wal dura dhaabbachuu

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Fara’oonii fi waraanni isaa bishaaniin liqimfaman
Dallaan magaalattii iyya irraa kan ka'e jige
outcome.answer: Fara’oonii fi waraanni isaa bishaaniin liqimfaman

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
